about.title: The Story Behind Susan-mini-crochet
about.subtitle: Slow-crafted keepsakes stitched with patience, warmth, and premium soft yarns.
about.storyParagraph1: Welcome to Susan-mini-crochet! What started as a cozy passion for turning soft pastel yarn into tiny charms for friends and family has blossomed into a dedicated handmade crochet studio.
about.storyParagraph2: Every single keychain, everlasting flower, plushie in our catalog is 100% hand-crocheted stitch by stitch. Unlike mass-produced items, each piece carries the warmth and durability of careful handcraftsmanship.
about.highlightQuote: We use skin-friendly milk cotton and premium acrylic yarns so your crochet treasures stay soft, vibrant, and huggable for years.

careTips.title: Gentle Hand Wash Only
careTips.text: Soak gently in cool or lukewarm water with a mild liquid detergent or baby shampoo. Avoid harsh wringing or scrubbing.

careTips.title: Air Dry Flat in Shade
careTips.text: Press out excess water gently with a clean towel and lay flat on a dry surface away from direct harsh sunlight.

careTips.title: No Machine Wash or Bleach
careTips.text: Never use a washing machine, tumble dryer, bleach, or hot iron, as heat and friction can stretch or fuzz the yarn fibers.

careTips.title: Dusting Crochet Flowers
careTips.text: For crochet flower bouquets, use a soft makeup brush or cool hairdryer setting from a distance to keep petals dust-free.

faqs.question: How do I place an order on Susan-mini-crochet?
faqs.answer: Simply browse our Shop Catalog, click 'Add to Cart' on the items you love, open your Cart Drawer, enter your delivery address, choose UPI, or Cash on Delivery (COD) with minimum down payment, and click 'Send Order on WhatsApp'.

faqs.question: What is the difference between 'Ready to Ship' and 'Made to Order'?
faqs.answer: 'Ready to Ship' items are dispatched within 1–2 business days. 'Made to Order' pieces are freshly crocheted for you and take will 4-5 business days before dispatch.

faqs.question: Do you offer Cash on Delivery (COD)?
faqs.answer: Yes! You can select UPI (GPay, PhonePe, Paytm), or Cash on Delivery (COD) right inside the checkout cart. But on COD we will charge little extra shipping and security charges and a minimum amount of down payment. I hope you understand the hassle.

faqs.question: How much is shipping and how long does delivery take?
faqs.answer: Standard shipping is ₹60 across India, and FREE on orders above ₹999. Delivery usually takes 3-12 business days depending on your PIN code.
